Strategy: Refine Best Fit with a sliver penalty: keep the tightness score but subtract a penalty when the post-placement residual is a tiny nonzero sliver below item/4, since such leftovers rarely fit another item. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin would leave a sliver while a looser bin leaves a usable residual or an exact fit. Avoiding slivers may preserve usable space, but the penalty can pass over good tight fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) - (30 if 0 < r - item < item / 4 else 0) for r in bins]
```
